label: mid-prefix input v (or first-occurrence e/o/x/3/j/c/z/t in sequences starting with 0/y/b)
explanation: Fires only during the original (input) phase, never at t<2, the delimiter, or the copy phase. Activity peaks at positions 3-5 (about 90% of mass at t=3..6). The strongest driver is the input token v (13x lift, 51% of mass); the top activations are almost all v at t=3-5. Other first-occurrence inputs (e, o, x, 3, j, c, z, t) also fire, mainly when the sequence starts with 0, y or b. The first token sets magnitude: v in sequences starting with 0/y/b/1/q is about 88% precise and gives the largest activations. The unit acts like an additive mix of current token, first token and position, not a clean boolean. Repeated tokens (in_first=0) rarely fire, and v at t=2 or t>=7, or in sequences with other first tokens, often does not. The predicate reaches dev F1 0.52 and mass recall 0.76.
